# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "V3002 effect_label_not_permitted"
description: "A closed effect row was required to be empty or smaller, but an effect label had to be in it (row unification {A | r} ~ {} failed, design §5.2)."
---

An error from the `effect` phase. `sakura explain V3002` prints this explanation offline.

A closed effect row was required to be empty or smaller, but an effect label had to be in it
(row unification `{A | r} ~ {}` failed, design §5.2). The usual cause is passing an effectful
function where a parameter's type is a pure `fn() -> T`. Make the parameter's row a variable so
the callee carries the argument's effects through, or handle the effect before passing the
function.

Wrong:

```sakura
fn apply(f: fn() -> Int) -> Int { f() }
fn noisy() -> Int ! {Console} { apply(loud_one) }
```

Fixed:

```sakura
fn apply<e>(f: fn() -> Int ! e) -> Int ! e { f() }
```

## Wrong program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V3002_effect_label_not_permitted.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/master/compiler/tests/ui/V3002_effect_label_not_permitted.sak), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:

```sakura
fn apply(f: fn() -> Int) -> Int { f() }

fn loud_one() -> Int ! {Console} {
  Console.print("side effect")
  1
}

fn noisy() -> Int ! {Console} { apply(loud_one) }
```
